ASN SCREEN CHANGES

###### Contents
1. Scope 2
2. Purpose 2
3. Solution 2
3.1 Screen Layout 2
3.2 ASN Details Tab 3
3.3 Shipment Details Tab 13
3.4 Attachments & Other Details Tab 15
3.5 Validation Messages 16

# Scope
In scope
• Layout of the ASN screen: page header, toolbar and the three header tabs (ASN Details, Shipment Details, Attachments & Other Details)
• ASN Information section and the Summary Total, with company-currency and document-currency columns
• Detail tabs on ASN Details: Order Details, Shipment Details, Additional Charge, Style Details, Advance License & EPCG License and Packing List
• Shipment Details and Commercial Invoice & Commercial Terms sections on the Shipment Details header tab
• New Attachments & Other Details header tab, holding Attachments, Flex Field and Other Fields (moved from the Packing List tab)
• On-screen calculations and validation messages for Advance License, EPCG License and Packing List
Out of scope
• Processing behind Save, Confirm and Exit; the prototype shows the buttons only
• Master data and the option values of dropdowns that are not listed in this document
• Import and export file formats of the Packing List (Copy From Factory Packing List, import and download formats are placeholders in the prototype)
• Sample values shown in the prototype (for example buyer names, licence numbers, quantities); they are for illustration only

# Purpose
The ASN screen carries a large number of sections on one page. This change groups them into three header tabs so that ASN-level data, shipment and commercial data, and attachments and other fields each have their own place. The Summary Total stays visible at the top of the ASN Details tab and shows each value in the company currency and the document currency side by side.

# Solution

## Screen Layout
The screen has a page title, a toolbar (Save, Confirm, Exit) and a row of three header tabs. Only one header tab is shown at a time. The ASN Details tab is open when the screen loads.

### Header Tabs

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 3 rows · columns: Header tab (text), Content (text)]
| Header tab | Content |
| ASN Details | ASN Information section with the Summary Total, followed by six detail tabs |
| Shipment Details | Shipment Details section and Commercial Invoice & Commercial Terms section |
| Attachments & Other Details | Attachments, Flex Field and Other Fields |

### Page Toolbar

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 3 rows · columns: Button (text), Behaviour (text)]
| Button | Behaviour |
| Save | Saves the ASN. Processing is not part of this document. |
| Confirm | Confirms the ASN. Processing is not part of this document. |
| Exit | Closes the ASN screen. |
Note: Tools will work as it is.

## ASN Details Tab
The tab has the ASN Information section at the top and the detail tabs below it. Invoice no. and Invoice Date fields are picked here from Commercial invoice section that earlier comes in shipping info section.
ASN Details tab (Order Details tab open)
Note: screen shown here is the HTML prototype, for reference.

### ASN Information
The section opens expanded. Clicking the chevron or the section title collapses it to a title bar and expands it again. The Summary Total sits at the right of the section (see 3.2.2). Fields marked Yes under Mandatory carry a red marker on the left of the field.

### Summary Total
The Summary Total shows four rows. Value, Additional Charge Value and Net Value are shown in two columns. The first column is the company currency and the second column is the document currency. Each column has a heading ("Company Currency", "Doc Currency"), and each amount is followed by its currency symbol and shows two decimals (the prototype uses Rs for the company currency and $ for the document currency). All amounts are 0.00 when the screen opens.

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 4 rows · columns: S. No. (integer), Row (text), Display and Logic (text)]
| S. No. | Row | Display and Logic |
| 1 | Total Quantity | One value, not split by currency, right-aligned under the Doc Currency column.
Proposed logic: total Shipping Qty of the Shipment Details grid. To be discussed and finalized. |
| 2 | Value | Company Currency | Doc Currency.
Proposed logic: total value of the Shipment Details grid in document currency; company currency = document currency value x Exchange Rate. To be discussed and finalized. |
| 3 | Additional Charge Value | Company Currency | Doc Currency.
Proposed logic: total Amount of the Additional Charges grid, converted with the Exchange Rate. To be discussed and finalized. |
| 4 | Net Value | Company Currency | Doc Currency. Last row, shown highlighted.
Proposed logic: Value + Additional Charge Value. To be discussed and finalized. |

### Detail Tabs
Six detail tabs sit below the ASN Information section. The Order Details tab is open by default. Clicking a tab shows its content and hides the others; the active tab is shown in white and raised above the others.

[TABLE 5: Table 5 · 7 rows · columns: Detail tab (text), Sections on the tab (text) · identifiers: Detail tab]
| Detail tab | Sections on the tab |
| Order Details | Order Details grid |
| Shipment Details | Shipment Details grid |
| FG Allocation | FG Allocation Detail Grid |
| Additional Charge | Additional Charges grid
Article Wise Additional Charges grid |
| Style Details | Style Details grid |
| Advance License & EPCG License | Advance License
EPCG License |
| Packing List | Packing List (number and date)
Packing List grid
Packing Information |
Captions in the grid tables below are listed without the "(en)" language suffix. Captions that appear cut off in the prototype grid header (ending in "...") are listed in full form and are to be confirmed against the label master.

### Order Details
Grid with the toolbar actions Add and Delete. A checkbox at the start of each row selects the row; the header checkbox selects all rows. The last row of the grid shows totals for Ordered Qty and Total Shipping.

### Shipment Details (Detail Tab)
Grid with a horizontal scroll bar. Toolbar: Allocate GST Charges (link), Export, Import. The last row shows totals for Ordered Qty, Shipped Qty, Shipping Qty and the Total amount, with the label Total under the Size column. The Shipping Qty total is updated by the Update Shipping Qty action of the Packing List tab (see 3.2.9).

### FG Allocation
Note: screen will be in 4.0 this is just for reference.

### Additional Charge
The tab has two sections one is for Additional charge article wise & second is footer charges. The Allocate GST Charges link sits at the right of the Additional Charges title bar.
Additional Charge tab

#### Additional Charges grid
The last row shows the total of the Amount column.

#### Article Wise Additional Charges grid
Grid with a horizontal scroll bar and a two-level header. The DISCOUNT and IGST groups each hold six columns. The last row shows totals for Amount (Tr Curr), the Amt columns of both groups and the two Total

### Style Details
Grid shown as read-only text, with a horizontal scroll bar.

### Advance License & EPCG License
The tab has two sections one below the other: Advance License and EPCG License.
Advance License & EPCG License tab

#### Advance License
Toolbar: Add adds a row with UOM MTR; Delete is enabled only when at least one row is ticked and removes the ticked rows. SNo is renumbered after every add or delete. An information strip above the grid shows StyleName/Code/BSR, OC Num and Shipment Qty.
The footer row shows totals of Total Consumption (Actual), Total Allocated Qty and Balance Qty. A row that breaks a rule is highlighted in red and the message is shown below the grid (see 3.5).

#### EPCG License
Toolbar: Add adds an empty row; Delete works as in Advance License. An information strip above the grid shows Shipment Date, Shipment Value, Total Allocated and Unallocated. Unallocated = Shipment Value - Total Allocated.
The footer row shows totals of Duty Saved, Export Obligation Value, EO Fulfilled Value, Balance EO Value, Allocate Value and Balance After Allocation. A row that breaks a rule is highlighted in red and the message is shown below the grid (see 3.5).

### Packing List
The tab holds three sections: Packing List (number and date), the Packing List grid with its toolbar, and Packing Information.
Packing List tab

## Attachments & Other Details Tab
New header tab, placed after Shipment Details. It holds three sections, one below the other, that were earlier at the bottom of the Packing List tab. Fields, controls and behaviour are the same as before the move.
Attachments & Other Details tab
